ItemID: NA; Title: Echo Dot (3rd Gen, 2018 release) - Smart speaker with Alexa - Charcoal; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My recently purchased fourth-generation Dot already fills this role, so an older model adds little for me.
ItemID: NA; Title: Echo Show 5 (1st Gen, 2019 release) -- Smart display with Alexa – stay connected with video calling - Charcoal; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I already have a second-generation Show 5 and just bought its stand, so I would skip this older version.
ItemID: NA; Title: Fire TV Stick 4K streaming device with Alexa Voice Remote (includes TV controls) | Dolby Vision; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My recent Fire TV Stick 4K Max bundle already covers streaming and Alexa TV controls.
ItemID: NA; Title: Echo Show 8 (1st Gen, 2019 release) -- HD smart display with Alexa – stay connected with video calling - Sandstone; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: A larger Alexa display interests me, but I would hold off while I use my recently purchased Show 5.
ItemID: NA; Title: Fire TV Stick 4K, brilliant 4K streaming quality, TV and smart home controls, free and live TV; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I do not currently need another streaming stick after buying the 4K Max bundle.
ItemID: NA; Title: SanDisk 256GB Extreme microSDXC UHS-I Memory Card with Adapter - Up to 160MB/s, C10, U3, V30, 4K, A2, Micro SD - SDSQXA1-256G-GN6MA; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Expandable storage fits my accessory purchases, but I would check device compatibility and an actual storage need before choosing it.
ItemID: NA; Title: Blink Video Doorbell | Two-way audio, HD video, motion and chime app alerts, and Alexa enabled — wired or wire-free (White); ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would try this for checking visitors through my Alexa devices; it adds a useful function alongside my earlier door and window alarm purchase.
ItemID: NA; Title: Ring Charging Station for Quick Release Battery Packs; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have no indicated Ring device or compatible battery packs that would make this charger useful.
ItemID: NA; Title: Echo Auto (1st gen) - Hands-free Alexa in your car with your phone; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Hands-free Alexa appeals to me, but I would first check whether it offers enough benefit with my phone and car setup.
ItemID: NA; Title: Blink Mini – Compact indoor plug-in smart security camera, 1080p HD video, night vision, motion detection, two-way audio, easy set up, Works with Alexa – 3 cameras (Black); ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Alexa-compatible home monitoring interests me, but I would start with the doorbell before committing to three indoor cameras.
